title: Crispy French Pork Ribs
description: A classic French-inspired dish featuring crispy fried pork ribs served with a side of tangy BBQ sauce.
instructions: Rinse the pork ribs and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a shallow dish, mix together flour, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Dredge the pork ribs in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Beat the eggs in a separate dish.
Dip the floured ribs in the beaten eggs, coating them evenly.
Dredge the egg-coated ribs in the flour mixture again, pressing the coating onto the meat to adhere.
Heat about 1/2 inch (1 cm) of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the coated ribs until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the fried ribs to a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 10-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve the crispy ribs with a side of tangy BBQ sauce for dipping.
